correctness.rationale: For n>=4, the alternating derivation identity on [e2,e3]=0 forces D(e2) to have no e1 coordinate, and recursion on [e1,ej] yields the complete unique block parametrization (a,v,w). For a=0, multiplication-operator valuation and the position of v give the first histogram terms. For a!=0 in characteristic two, the recursively unique z(s) satisfying z+s*f1*z^2=f1 conjugates E+f to E+h(t^2); parity splitting and a uniform translation f0->h give exact resonant multiplicities W_ell(j), including truncation boundaries. Both constant nonresonance and all cases are disjoint/exhaustive; coefficient sum is q^(2n-1). A standalone verifier constructs actual derivations/ranks across exhaustive and sampled finite-field cases and separately checks gauge-conjugation identities. Finite checks corroborate rather than establish universal quantifiers.
